```{r setup-tables, include=FALSE}

# Load data.  Rescale to SI units. Random Forests are insensitive to rescaling, so this is just 
# for presentation of results.
estimation_dataset <- bind_rows(
  training(data_split)   %>% mutate(partition = "train"),
  validation(data_split) %>% mutate(partition = "validation"),
  testing(data_split)    %>% mutate(partition = "test")
)

vars_to_rescale <- c("priceR_CPI",
                     "lndlb",
                     "trip_level_BSB",
                     "StateOtherQJumbo",     
                     "StateOtherQLarge",    
                     "StateOtherQMedium",   
                     "StateOtherQSmall",  
                     "StockareaOtherQJumbo", 
                     "StockareaOtherQLarge",
                     "StockareaOtherQMedium",
                     "StockareaOtherQSmall",
                     "MA7_StockareaQJumbo",
                     "MA7_StockareaQLarge",  
                     "MA7_StockareaQMedium", 
                     "MA7_StockareaQSmall",
                     "MA7_StateQJumbo",      
                     "MA7_StateQLarge",      
                     "MA7_StateQMedium",     
                     "MA7_StateQSmall",      
                     "MA7_gearQJumbo",      
                     "MA7_gearQLarge",       
                     "MA7_gearQMedium",      
                     "MA7_gearQSmall")      




#remove the hardhat fweight declaration and add a noweights=1 columnn to make it easier to generate the unweighted columns.
estimation_dataset4tables<-estimation_dataset %>%
  mutate(
    weighting = as.numeric(weighting),
    noweights=1)

estimation_dataset4tables<-estimation_dataset4tables %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(vars_to_rescale),
      ~ .x / lbs_per_kg,
      .names = "{.col}_kg"
    )
  )

# --- Weighted SD (frequency weights) ---
weighted_sd <- function(x, w) {
  valid <- complete.cases(x, w)
  x <- x[valid]
  w <- w[valid]
  xbar <- weighted.mean(x, w)
  sqrt(sum(w * (x - xbar)^2) / (sum(w) - 1))
}

# --- Market description level order; month labels ---

month_labels <- c("Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun",
```

```{r tbl-cont-A, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='hide'}
# --- Continuous variable table ---

compute_cont_group <- function(data, var, wt) {
  data %>%
    group_by(market_desc) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_val = weighted.mean(.data[[var]], .data[[wt]], na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_val   = weighted_sd(.data[[var]], .data[[wt]]),
      .groups  = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(cell = sprintf("\\makecell{%.2f \\\\ (%.2f)}", mean_val, sd_val))
}

compute_cont_total <- function(data, var, wt) {
  m <- weighted.mean(data[[var]], data[[wt]], na.rm = TRUE)
  s <- weighted_sd(data[[var]], data[[wt]])
  sprintf("\\makecell{%.2f \\\\ (%.2f)}", m, s)
}

cont_rows <- lapply(names(cont_vars), function(v) {
  grp <- compute_cont_group( estimation_dataset4tables, v, "weighting")
  tot <- compute_cont_total( estimation_dataset4tables, v, "weighting")

  grp %>%
    select(market_desc, cell) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = market_desc, values_from = cell) %>%
    mutate(Variable = cont_vars[[v]], Total = tot) %>%
    select(Variable, all_of(mkt_levels), Total)
})

Weighted_cont_table <- bind_rows(cont_rows)
Weighted_cont_table_notot <- Weighted_cont_table %>%
  select(-Total)



################################################################################
# UNWEIGHTED TABLE
cont_rowsUW <- lapply(names(cont_vars), function(v) {
  grp <- compute_cont_group( estimation_dataset4tables, v, "noweights")
  tot <- compute_cont_total( estimation_dataset4tables, v, "noweights")

  grp %>%
    select(market_desc, cell) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = market_desc, values_from = cell) %>%
    mutate(Variable = cont_vars[[v]], Total = tot) %>%
    select(Variable, all_of(mkt_levels), Total)
})

UnWeighted_cont_table <- bind_rows(cont_rowsUW)
UnWeighted_cont_table_notot <- UnWeighted_cont_table %>%
  select(-Total)
#This will be printed in the appendix
################################################################################

```

```{r build-tbl-cat-time, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='hide'}
# --- Categorical table 1: Month and Year ---

compute_cat_group <- function(data, var, wt) {
  data %>%
    group_by(market_desc, .data[[var]]) %>%
    summarise(w = sum(.data[[wt]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(market_desc) %>%
    mutate(pct = sprintf("%.1f", 100 * w / sum(w))) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(market_desc, level = all_of(var), pct)
}

compute_cat_total <- function(data, var, wt) {
  data %>%
    group_by(.data[[var]]) %>%
    summarise(w = sum(.data[[wt]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(pct = sprintf("%.1f", 100 * w / sum(w))) %>%
    rename(level = all_of(var)) %>%
    select(level, pct)
}

build_cat_table <- function(data, var_list, wt) {
  rows <- lapply(names(var_list), function(v) {
    grp <- compute_cat_group(data, v, wt)
    tot <- compute_cat_total(data, v, wt)

    wide <- grp %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = market_desc, values_from = pct) %>%
      left_join(tot %>% rename(Total = pct), by = "level") %>%
      mutate(
        level    = as.character(level),
        Variable = ifelse(row_number() == 1, var_list[[v]], ""),
        level    = paste0("\\quad ", level)
      ) %>%
      select(Variable, Level = level, all_of(mkt_levels), Total)

    wide
  })
  bind_rows(rows)
}

cat_vars_time_geo_table <- build_cat_table( estimation_dataset4tables, cat_vars_time_geo, "weighting")
cat_vars_time_geo_table_notot <-cat_vars_time_geo_table %>%
  select(-Total)

UWcat_vars_time_geo_table_notot <-UWcat_vars_time_geo_table %>%
  select(-Total)

################################################################################
```
